description: Translate a landing page's SIDE pages (pricing, comparison pages, ...) into a language. `slug` is the SOURCE landing page. The landing page must already have a variant in the target language (run create_landing_page_translation first). Translated side pages keep the SAME slug and live under the variant (e.g. /cs/pricing). Pass exactly one of `sidePageSlugs` or `all`. Translations are created as DRAFTS unless `publish: true` (which publishes only pages whose source is published). Existing translations are skipped (listed in `skipped`) unless `overwrite: true`, which writes a new draft version and deletes nothing. Costs 25 credits per translated page (skipped and failed pages are not charged). Runs as a background operation: returns { operationId, variantSlug, language, queued, skipped } — poll operationId with get_job. Language tags (hreflang) between the two versions appear automatically once both are published. Use get_side_page_translations to see status.

all.description: Translate every side page. Mutually exclusive with `sidePageSlugs`.

language.description: Target language, as a BCP-47 code. One of: en, es, pt-BR, de, fr, cs.

overwrite.description: Re-translate pages that already have a translation (writes a new draft version).

publish.description: Publish translated pages whose source is published. Default false (drafts).

sidePageSlugs.description: Side-page slugs to translate. Mutually exclusive with `all`.

name: create_side_page_translation
